# Morpheus same-version transparent OpenGL config preference

Baseline: complete published i-slint-backend-winit 1.18.1 archive, SHA256 dae4fcf1b19e9cb109984d2af87d2b9485388c619265bff71dd523133888bee2. Recorded upstream revision: 372cf0ee5577c3dfec309a45e7b778ba4e81b734; upstream package path: internal/backends/winit.

All 40 original regular 0644 archive members are preserved. Only renderer/femtovg/glcontext.rs changes: the production reducer calls one new pure preference helper file, with two bounded regressions. Every original native GL setup/unsafe body remains exact. Cargo.toml, its original empty development table, Cargo.toml.orig, upstream Cargo.lock, build.rs, original integration tests, attribution, and all three LICENSES texts remain exact. Cargo.toml.upstream additionally preserves the full published normalized manifest.

Known transparency is preferred over opaque or unidentified support; samples only break ties within the same known-transparency class. None remains unidentified and can still work. An opaque/unidentified fallback stays available when no known-transparent config exists. Equal sample ties retain the previous native iterator entry. Sample attributes are not queried to override different transparency classes. No new native query, config filter, GL creation, fallback renderer, input-region, menu, theme, or compositor policy is added.

The current default feature graph reaches this OpenGL path. A permitted X11 GLX configuration domain can place known-transparent/sample4/no-caveat before known-opaque/sample0/slow; the previous OR reducer could discard transparency and finalize an opaque native window despite an eligible transparent config. This is source-domain proof, not an observed driver failure. macOS CGL's one transparent config and Wayland EGL's alpha8 configs do not establish that mixed known-false case.

Root excludes this same-version path patch from workspace development features. No normal/build/target dependency, feature/default, package version, build hook or development table is changed. The upstream normalized manifest has no Slint development edge, while its original cfg(test) library module references unpublished dev Slint APIs. Those tests remain source-exact and are not selected or disabled. Existing vendor verification instead selects two literal cases in morpheus-app's ordinary gl_config_preference integration target, with its existing native-calls feature and build graph. That target includes the SAME new pure file consumed by production glcontext, without copying an algorithm, enabling backend cfg(test), or adding a dependency. The cases exercise the actual production helper without creating GL/window/native resources. They do not replace native renderer/compositor/installed acceptance.

Original license declaration remains GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0 OR LicenseRef-Slint-Software-3.0. Complete supplied GPL, royalty-free and software-plan texts and copyrights are retained unchanged. This provenance record does not select a license grant or assert legal distribution approval. Existing corresponding-source/notice collectors discover this root path manifest, its nested LICENSES and this explanation without a new whitelist or relaxed source policy.

The new pure helper and integration entry carry the project AGPL-3.0-or-later source attribution. Original upstream license declarations/texts are preserved; this record does not extend upstream commercial/royalty-free grants to local changes or claim a distribution license route.
